verdict.rationale: Parsec documents audit logs for Teams, with "Full audit logs via Teams API" and a tier offering "Audit logs (last 7 days)", plus API access for reporting. Pulling logs through the API suggests they can be exported. However, nothing in the evidence shows the logs record who connected to which machine and when, and one tier keeps only 7 days of history. missing for 10: documented connection-event fields (user, machine, timestamp), an explicit export format or audit-export workflow, retention details beyond 7 days, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit
